name: watiq-frontend
description: Tailwind build for the Watiq National Portal Flask frontend. Replaces the Tailwind Play CDN, which JIT-compiles in the browser and cannot satisfy the production CSP (script-src 'self').

scripts.build: tailwindcss -i static/src/watiq.css -o static/css/watiq.css --minify && node tools/scale-text.js static/css/watiq.css
